text.p: -- Vector Securities International said it began coverage of NaPro BioTherapeutics Inc with a buy rating and a year-end 1997 target price range of $24 to $30 a share.

-- "We believe that NaPro and its licensees will be second on the market with paclitaxel, an $800 million anti-cancer drug still in the growth phase of its life cycle," Vector said in a report dated September 10.
-- "NaPro's drug has captured 50 percent market share in Australia, and we expect it to capture a significant share of the U.S. and European market as well," it said.
-- On Wednesday, NaPro was up 1/2 at 11 at 1400 EDT/1800 GMT.
